name: How long does a typical bathroom remodel take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical bathroom remodel take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a bathroom remodel varies based on the scope of work. A minor refresh, like updating fixtures and paint, might take 1-2 weeks. A complete renovation involving layout changes, plumbing, and electrical work could take 3-6 weeks. Factors like material availability and inspection schedules can also influence the timeline. We provide a detailed project schedule before starting any work.
acceptedAnswer.description: A typical bathroom remodel can take anywhere from 1-2 weeks for minor updates to 3-6 weeks for a complete renovation, depending on the scope.
